description: This computational grid assembles the Arakawa C-grid staggering used by MOM6, shared with SIS2 (sea ice) through the Flexible Modeling System (FMS) coupling infrastructure. Scalar (mass) variables — temperature, salinity, and tracers — are located at the h-points (cell centers); the zonal velocity component is staggered at the u-points (east/west cell faces); and the meridional velocity component is staggered at the points (north/south cell faces). MOM6 and SIS2 share this identical horizontal grid and staggering, allowing direct coupling between the ocean and sea ice components without interpolation between different grid layouts.
